paint.viewer.control

Class CellAssignmentManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.viewer.control.CellAssignmentManager

  • public class CellAssignmentManager
extends Object
    Handles cell assignment operations for a grid of Square objects.

    Provides:

    • Assigning a common cell ID to all currently selected squares.
    • Undoing the latest assignment by restoring the previous state.
    • Clearing state when switching recordings.
    All repainting is delegated to the SquareGridPanel.

    • Method Detail

      • assignUserSelectedSquares

        public Map<Integer,Integer> assignUserSelectedSquares(int cellId,
                                                      SquareGridPanel grid)
        Assigns the specified cell ID to all user-selected squares.

        The current assignment map is copied and pushed onto the undo stack before any modification occurs, ensuring a reversible operation.

        Parameters:
        cellId - ID to assign to each selected square
        grid - the grid panel containing square objects and selection info
        Returns:
        an unmodifiable view of the updated squareAssignments map

      • undo

        public void undo(SquareGridPanel grid)
        Reverts the most recent assignment operation.

        Restores the assignment map to the previous snapshot and applies the restored values to the grid's square objects, followed by a repaint.

        Parameters:
        grid - the grid panel whose displayed squares must be updated

      • clear
